cards.title: Shell-Shock
incapacitatedAbilities: One player may play a card.
One hero may use a power.
One player may draw a card.

openingLines.default: Let's see if this is enough to get me out of my shell.

cards.title: Rooftop Reconnissance
body: Draw 3 cards.
You may use a power now.

flavorQuotes.text: It's a good way to {br}keep an eye on things, as long as {br}][you don't misjudge the jump.

cards.title: Zap-Lad
body: When one of your Vehicle targets would take lightning damage, prevent that damage and that Vehicle regains 1 HP instead.
At the end of your turn, this card deals 1 target 1 lightning damage.

flavorQuotes.text: Eh, sure, I've kinda outgrown it, {br}but I'm still passingly fond of the name.

cards.title: Shell-Copter
body: When this card enters play, destroy any of your other Vehicle cards in play.
At the start of your turn, this card deals itself 3 lightning damage.
Each Hero gains the following power:
[b]Power:[/b] {ShellCopter} deals up to 2 targets 2 projectile damage each.

flavorQuotes.text: How many guns {br}did you install on that thing?

cards.title: Canvas the Scene
body: Discard the top card of each deck.
If {ZapLad} is in play, move the top card of a trash pile to the top of its deck.
If {ZapLad} is not in play, search your deck and trash for {ZapLad}, put it into play, and shuffle your trash into your deck.

flavorQuotes.text: Yep, I'm here. {br}And yep, that's blood.

cards.title: Vehicular Defense
body: After a non-hero target deals one of your Vehicle targets damage each turn, {ShellShockCharacter} deals that non-Hero target 2 melee damage.
powers: You may play a vehicle card.

flavorQuotes.text: They always expect me {br}to be the one driving.

cards.title: Shell-Buggie
body: When this card enters play, destroy any of your other Vehicle cards in play.
At the start of your turn, this card deals itself 3 lightning damage.
Each Hero gains the following power:
[b]Power:[/b] {ShellBuggie} deals 1 targets 3 melee damage.

flavorQuotes.text: I'm not sure where {br}the "shell" part comes into play. {br}I'll install a green cover later.

cards.title: Plans and Payoff
body: After a vehicle target enters play, it deals 1 target 2 melee damage.
When this card is destroyed, you may destroy an Ongoing or Environment card and {ShellShockCharacter} deals 1 target 2 melee and 2 lightning damage.

flavorQuotes.text: Your speech was so long {br}my reinforcements are here. Good job.

cards.title: Emergency Landing
body: After one of your Vehicle cards is destroyed, draw 2 cards and Shell Shock regains 1 HP.
powers: One of your Vehicle cards deals 1 target 2 melee damage and 3 fire damage. Destroy that vehicle card.

flavorQuotes.text: I try to crash things {br}where there's a safe landing spot. {br}Mud's one of the better options.

cards.title: Measured Assault
body: {ShellShockCharacter} deals 1 targets 4 melee damage.
{ShellShockCharacter} deals up to 4 targets 1 lightning damage each.

flavorQuotes.text: I'd feel worse {br}if they weren't all trying to kill me.

cards.title: Knife-Fight
body: Increase melee damage dealt by {ShellShockCharacter} by 1.
Reduce melee damage dealt to {ShellShockCharacter} by 1.
powers: {ShellShockCharacter} deals up to 3 targets 1 melee damage.

flavorQuotes.text: I'm still not sure if knives {br}fit your schtick, but I'll accept your challenge.

cards.title: In the Weeds
body: When there is a device card in play, increase damage dealt by {ShellShockCharacter} by 1.
After the first time one of your targets deals damage to a non-Hero target each turn, {ShellShockCharacter} deals that non-hero target 1 melee damage.

flavorQuotes.text: I've studied most machines. {br}There are some glaring weaknesses I can {br}take advantage of.

cards.title: Eye from Above
body: The first time a non-Hero target enters play each turn, you may use a power.

flavorQuotes.text: I'm ready for anything. {br}Even that giant rabbit attack.

cards.title: Shell-Glider
body: When this card enters play, destroy any of your other Vehicle cards in play.
At the start of your turn, this card deals itself 3 lightning damage.
Reduce damage dealt to {ShellShockCharacter} by 1.

flavorQuotes.text: I don't know why he insisted {br}on a geared-up hang glider, but {br}it's come in handy some days.

cards.title: "Borrowed" Blimp
body: When this card enters play, destroy any of your other Vehicle cards in play.
At the start of your turn, this card deals itself 3 lightning damage.
Each Hero gains the following power:
[b]Power:[/b] Draw 1 card. This hero regains 1 HP.

flavorQuotes.text: Look, you can only crash {br}a blimp so many times before you start {br}looking for an alternate supply.

cards.title: Left Unspoken
body: Draw 1 card. {ShellShockCharacter} regains 4 HP.
Another player draws 1 card. Their Hero regains 4 HP.

promoCards.title: Zap-Lad
setup: Remove each other copy of {ZapLad} in your deck from the game.
powers: Draw 1 card. You may select a device target. It regains 2 HP and reduce damage dealt to it by 1 until the end of your next turn.
incapacitatedAbilities: One player may play a card.
One hero may use a power.
One player may draw a card.

openingLines.default: Everything's still here and ready - even I can handle you!

promoCards.title: The Orca
powers: Until the start of your next turn, at the end of each non-Hero turn, {ShellShockCharacter} deals each target in that turn's play area one melee damage.
incapacitatedAbilities: One player may play a card.
One hero may use a power.
One player may draw a card.

openingLines.default: Guess someone has to pick up the slack while Shelly's busy.
